cultures.name: Malwai
cultures.region: Madhya Pradesh — Malwa plateau (Ujjain, Indore, Dewas, Ratlam)
cultures.dialect_notes: Blend of Hindi and Rajasthani. Uses 'sa' as softener. Kinship terms differ from standard Hindi. Distinctive verb endings like 'karvo', 'jaavo'.
cultures.honorifics: sa suffix for respect (e.g., Hukum sa, Bai sa)
common_idioms: Bole so meetho, na bole so peetho
cultures.architecture: Sandstone haveli, open courtyard (aangan), carved wooden lintels, neem tree centre, raised verandah (otla)
cultures.typical_wardrobe_male: Dhoti-kurta, angarkha, pagdi for elders, white cotton bandi for daily wear
cultures.typical_wardrobe_female: Lehenga-choli, cotton odhni with gota border, heavy silver borla and kardhani jewellery
cultures.typical_wardrobe_male_or_female: Traditional Malwa cottons with bandhani/leheriya touches and silver adornments
taboos: Calling elders by their first name
Stepping over the courtyard threshold with footwear
Serving food with the left hand

social_structure.elder_authority: Elders hold absolute veto in family and property disputes
social_structure.family_hierarchy: Strict seniority protocol; younger members seek aashirwad before speaking in council

role_adaptations.Elder Son: Jyestha Putra / Bada Kunwar carrying family prestige

cultures.confidence_note: Compiled from documented regional ethnographic sources. Verify with native speaker before theatrical production.

cultures.name: Mewari
cultures.region: Rajasthan — Mewar division (Udaipur, Chittorgarh, Rajsamand, Bhilwara)
cultures.dialect_notes: A principal dialect of Rajasthani with strong phonological glottal emphasis, using 're' and 'hukum' extensively.
cultures.honorifics: Hukum, Banna sa, Baiji sa, Rao sa
common_idioms: Mewar ra mard kadi jhukya koni
cultures.architecture: Whitewashed stone courtyard palace/haveli, jharokha balconies, marble chhatris, central fountain or sacred tulsi vrindavan
cultures.typical_wardrobe_male: Tailored achkan or angarkhi, churidar, saffron or red Mewari pagri (turban), kamarbandh
cultures.typical_wardrobe_female: Ghoonghat covered lehenga, kanchli-kurti, embossed silver rakhdi, punchi bracelets
cultures.typical_wardrobe_male_or_female: Mewari royal-inspired or Rajputana cotton-silk with distinctive regional turban folds and silver jewellery
taboos: Uncovered head in presence of elders or temple shrine
Directly questioning family patriarch in public sabha
Refusing ceremonial opium/kasumba or sweet welcome token

social_structure.elder_authority: Chivalric code of honour (aan); patriarch holds solemn council judgment
social_structure.family_hierarchy: Warrior and clan loyalty dictates precedence; lineage reputation supersedes individual desires

cultures.confidence_note: Documented Rajasthani historical lineage and dialect research. Historical aristocratic dialect notes verified.

cultures.name: Majhi
cultures.region: Punjab — central belt (Amritsar, Gurdaspur, Tarn Taran, Lahore border)
cultures.dialect_notes: Prestigious central Punjabi dialect with tonal pitch accents (high-falling and low-rising tones) and hearty colloquial vocabulary.
cultures.honorifics: Ji suffix, Sardar ji, Bhau ji, Bebe ji
common_idioms: Anhe agge rona, akhiyan da khona
Dulleya beran da kujh ni vigdeya
cultures.architecture: Red brick kothi or ancestral haveli, expansive front deorhi (entrance vestibule), wide baithak, rooftop terrace with charpais
cultures.typical_wardrobe_male: Kurta-pyjama with vibrant phulkari vest or chadra, Majha style pointed turban (pagri/pagg), jutti
cultures.typical_wardrobe_female: Salwar-kameez, heavy embroidered phulkari dupatta, golden jhumkas and paranda in braided hair
cultures.typical_wardrobe_male_or_female: Majha Punjabi tailored cotton or silk suit with embroidered phulkari and traditional footwear
food: makki di roti te sarson da saag
taboos: Entering baithak or prayer area without head covering
Disrespecting community langar or grain harvest
Walking away from guest without serving lassi or water

social_structure.elder_authority: Bapu/Bebe guidance revered; joint family baithak holds consensus decisions
social_structure.family_hierarchy: Egalitarian community ethos with deep respect for parental labor and elder blessings

cultures.confidence_note: Standard Punjabi Majhi dialectology reference with classical folklore alignment.
